title: PRP for Hair Loss in Dubai: Sessions, Results & Cost
h1: PRP for hair loss: how it works, sessions and results
desc: PRP uses a concentrate of your own platelets to strengthen thinning hair. Most plans start with three to six sessions a month apart, with first changes around month three and maintenance sessions every four to six months.
answer: PRP uses a concentrate of your own platelets to strengthen thinning hair. Most plans start with three to six sessions a month apart, with first changes around month three and maintenance sessions every four to six months.
body:
PRP is one of the most widely used non-surgical treatments for thinning hair. It is simple, uses your own blood and fits easily around work. Here is what to expect.

## What is PRP?

PRP stands for **platelet-rich plasma**. A small blood sample is spun in a centrifuge to separate the platelets, which are rich in growth factors. This concentrate is then injected into thinning areas of the scalp to support the follicles.

## Does PRP work for hair loss?

Studies in male and female pattern hair loss show PRP can improve hair density and thickness for many patients. Results vary between people, and the benefit fades without maintenance, so we treat it as an ongoing part of a plan rather than a one-off cure.

PRP strengthens follicles that are still alive. It cannot grow hair where follicles have gone, which is when a [hair transplant](/treatments/hair-transplant-dubai/#fue-dhi) is the better option.

## What happens at a session?

- A small blood sample is taken, like a routine blood test.
- The sample is spun to concentrate the platelets.
- The scalp is cleaned and numbed.
- The plasma is injected across the thinning areas.

The visit takes under an hour, and you can return to work the same day.

## How many sessions?

- **Starting course:** three to six sessions, about four weeks apart
- **Review:** photos at around month three
- **Maintenance:** one session every four to six months

## What makes PRP work better?

PRP works best as part of a complete plan. That can include treating low iron or vitamin D, prescription treatment, [mesotherapy](/treatments/hair-transplant-dubai/#packages) and LED therapy. After a transplant, PRP supports healing and helps protect native hair around the grafts.

**PRP is most effective when we know why hair is thinning, not just where.**

## Who should avoid PRP?

PRP is not usually advised during pregnancy, with active scalp infection, with certain blood or platelet disorders, or while taking some blood-thinning medicines. Your doctor checks your history and medicines first.

When will I see results from PRP?
Many patients notice less shedding within two to three months and thicker hair from around month three to six.
The scalp is numbed first. Most people feel pressure and mild tenderness that settles the same day.
